h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Patiala

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Patiala

items.pText: Patiala sees the full range of north Indian weather in one year: May afternoons in the mid-forties, a humid monsoon and foggy winter mornings when the temperature drops close to freezing. A playground in the royal city has to be comfortable in all of it. That applies at its schools, its colonies and the campuses of its universities and sports institutions.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,270 km from Patiala. We send it to Punjab by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the north installs it. Send us the size of your site, the age group of the children and some photos. We will suggest equipment that stays usable through the seasons and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A playground for every season in Punjab

c: Bare metal surfaces get hot in summer and very cold in winter. Roto-moulded plastic slides, decks and seats stay closer to air temperature, so children can use them in both seasons. Galvanised steel frames resist the damp of the monsoon and the winter fog.

items.q: Can children use plastic slides in Patiala's winter?
items.a: Yes. Roto-moulded plastic does not get as cold to the touch as bare metal. Wipe off dew or frost on winter mornings before children play.

items.q: Should the whole play area be shaded?
items.a: Partial shade usually works best in Punjab. Shade the slides and the seating for summer afternoons and leave some of the area open to the winter sun.

items.q: Do you install equipment in Patiala and nearby cities?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Patiala, Ludhiana, Ambala and Panchkula, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.
